lines.text: David son of Jesse, anointed by the God of Jacob, speaks these last words as the sweet psalmist of Israel.
The Spirit of the LORD spoke through David, and the Rock of Israel said a ruler must rule with justice.
God says a ruler who rules in the fear of God is like the light of a cloudy evening.

wrong_details.true: morning light at sunrise of a cloudless dawn

lines.text: David says God made an everlasting covenant with him and will bring about his full salvation and every desire.
The worthless are like thorns raked aside, and anyone touching them needs a cloth or spear shaft, and fire burns them.
